title: René Descartes
summary: Rene Descartes (1596-1650), born at La Haye in Touraine, developed the techniques that made analytic geometry possible and set out a method of doubt to rebuild knowledge on certain foundations, starting from 'I think, therefore I am'. In the Discourse on the Method (1637) and Meditations (1641) he argued that mind and body are distinct substances and pressed a mechanistic account of nature, even of living bodies, in place of Aristotelian science. He lived mostly in the Netherlands, and died at Queen Christina's court in Sweden.

uncertainty.note: Born 31 March 1596 at La Haye en Touraine; died 11 February 1650 in Stockholm.
